sn35.244:1.1: Yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhu sabbesaññeva dukkhadhammānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañ ca yathābhūtam pajānāti ||
sn35.244:1.2: tathā kho panassa kāmā diṭṭhā honti yathāssa kāme passato yo kāmesu kāmacchando kāmasneho kāmamucchā kāmapariḷāho so nānuseti || ||
sn35.244:1.3: Tathā kho panassa cāro ca vihāro ca anubuddho hoti || yathā carantam abhijjhā domanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā nānusavanti || || 4
sn35.244:2.1: Kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu sabbesaṃ yeva dukkhadhammānaṃ samudayañ ca atthagamañca yathābhūtam pajānāti || ||
sn35.244:2.2: Iti rūpaṃ iti rūpassa samudayo iti rūpassa atthagamo || ||
sn35.244:2.6: Iti viññāṇaṃ iti viññāṇassa samudayo iti viññāṇassa atthagamo ti || ||
sn35.244:2.7: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu sabbesaṃ yeva dukkhadhammānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca yathābhūtam pajānāti || || 5
sn35.244:3.1: Kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhuno kāmā diṭṭhā honti || yathāssa kāme passato yo kāmesu kāmacchando kāmasneho kāmamucchā kāmapariḷāho so nānuseti || ||
sn35.244:3.2: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave aṅgārakāsu sādhikaporisā puṇṇā aṅgārānam vītaccikānam vītadhūmānaṃ || atha puriso āgaccheyya jīvitukāmo amaritukāmo sukhakāmo dukkhapaṭikulo || tam enaṃ dve balavanto purisā nānābāhāsu gahetvā tam aṅgārakāsum upakaḍḍheyyuṃ || so iticiticeva kāyaṃ sannāmeyya || ||
sn35.244:3.4: Ñātañhi bhikkhave tassa purisassa hoti || || Imaṃ khvāham aṅgārakāsum papatissāmi || tato nidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā gacchāmi maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhanti || ||
sn35.244:3.5: Evam eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno aṅgārakāsūpamā kāmā diṭṭhā honti yathāssa kāme passato yo kāmesu kāmacchando kāmasneho kāmamucchā kāmapariḷāho so nānuseti || || 6
sn35.244:4.1: Kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhuno cāro ca vihāro ca anubuddho hoti || yathā carantaṃ viharantam abhijjhā domanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā nānusavanti || ||
sn35.244:4.2: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso bahukaṇṭakaṃ dāyam paviseyya || tassa purato pi kaṇṭako pacchato pi kaṇṭako uttarato pi kaṇṭako dakkhiṇato pi kaṇṭako heṭṭhato pi kaṇṭako uparito pi kaṇṭako || so yato ca abhikkameyya yato ca paṭikkameyya Mā maṃ kaṇṭako ti || ||
sn35.244:4.3: Evam eva kho bhikkhave yaṃ loke pīyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ ayam vuccati ariyassa vinaye kaṇṭako ti || || 7
sn35.244:4.4: Iti viditvā saṃvaro ca asaṃvaro ca veditabbo || || 8
sn35.244:5.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā piyarūpe rūpe adhimuccati || apiyarūpe rūpe vyāpajjati || anupaṭṭhitakāyasatī ca viharati parittacetaso ||
sn35.244:5.3: tañca cetovimuttim paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ na pajānāti yatthassa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti || la ||
sn35.244:5.5: Manasā dhammaṃ viññāya piyarūpe dhamme adhimuccati || apiyarūpe dhamme vyāpajjati || anupaṭṭhitakāyasatī ca viharati parittacetaso ||
sn35.244:5.6: tañca cetovimuttim paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ na pajānāti yatthassa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti || ||
sn35.244:6.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā piyarūpe rūpe nādhimuccati || apiyarūpe rūpe na vyāpajjati || upaṭṭhitakāyasatī ca viharati appamāṇacetaso ||
sn35.244:6.3: tañca cetovimuttim paññavimuttiṃ yathābhūtam pajānāti yatthassa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti || pa ||
sn35.244:6.5: Manasā dhammaṃ viññāya piyarūpe dhamme nādhimuccati apiyarūpe dhamme na vyāpajjati || upaṭṭhitakāyasatī ca viharati appamāṇacetaso ||
sn35.244:6.6: tañca cetovimuttim paññavimuttiṃ yathābhūtam pajānāti yatthassa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti || ||
sn35.244:7.1: Tassa ce bhikkhave bhikkhuno evam carato evaṃ viharato kadāci karahaci satisammosā uppajjanti pāpakā akusalā dhammā sarasaṅkappā saṃyojaniyā || dandho bhikkhave satuppādo || atha kho naṃ khippam eva pajahati vinodeti vyantikaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti || ||
sn35.244:8.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso divasaṃ santatte ayokaṭāhe dve vā tīṇi vā udakaphusitāni nipāteyya || dandho bhikkhave udakaphusitānaṃ nipāto || atha kho nam khippam eva parikkhayam pariyādānaṃ gaccheyya || ||
sn35.244:8.2: Evam eva kho bhikkhave tassa ce bhikkhuno evaṃ viharato kadāci karahaci satisammosā uppajjanti pāpakā akusalā dhammā sarasaṅkappā saṃyojaniyā || dandho bhikkhave satuppādo || atha kho naṃ khippam eva pajahati vinodeti vyantikaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti || || 11
sn35.244:8.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno cāro ca vihāro ca anubuddho hoti || yathā carantaṃ viharantam abhijjhā domanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā nānussavanti ||
sn35.244:8.4: tañce bhikkhave bhikkhum evaṃ carantam evaṃ viharantam rājāno vā rājamahāmattā vā mittā vā amaccā vā ñātī vā sālohitā vā bhogehi abhihaṭṭhuṃ pavāreyyuṃ
sn35.244:8.5: Ehi bho puriso kiṃ te kāsāvā anudahanti ||
sn35.244:8.7: ehi hīnāyāvattitvā bhoge ca bhuñjassa puññāni ca karohīti ||
sn35.244:8.8: So vata bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ caranto evaṃ viharanto sikkham paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattisatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati || || 12
sn35.244:9.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave Gaṅgā nadī pācīnaninnā pācīnaponā pācīnapabbhārā || atha mahājanakāyo āgaccheyya kuddālapiṭakam ādāya Imaṃ Gaṅgānadim pacchāninnam karissāma pacchāpoṇam pacchāpabbhāranti || ||
sn35.244:9.3: api nu kho so mahājanakāyo Gaṅgā nadim pacchāninnaṃ kareyya pacchāpoṇaṃ pacchāpabbhāranti || ||
sn35.244:9.6: Gaṅgā nadī bhante pācimaninnā pācīnaponā pācīnapabbhārā
sn35.244:9.7: sā na sukarā pacchāninnaṃ kātum pacchāpoṇam pacchāpabbhāraṃ ||
sn35.244:9.8: yāvad eva ca pana so mahājanakāyo kilamathassa vighātassa bhāgī assāti || || 13
sn35.244:9.9: Evam eva kho bhikkhave tañce bhikkhum evaṃ carantam evaṃ viharantam rājāno vā rājamahāmattā vā mittā vā amaccā vā ñātī vā sālohitā vā bhogehi abhihaṭṭhuṃ pavāreyyuṃ ||
sn35.244:9.10: Ehambho purisa kiṃ te ime kāsāvā anudahanti
sn35.244:9.12: ehi hīnāyāvattitvā bhoge ca bhuñjassu puññāni ca karohīti ||
sn35.244:9.13: so vata bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ caranto evaṃ viharanto sikkham pacchakkhāya hināyāvattissatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati || ||
sn35.244:9.15: yaṃ hi tam bhikkhave cittaṃ dīgharattaṃ vivekaninnaṃ vivekapoṇaṃ vivekapabbhāraṃ tathā hīnāyāvattissatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjatīti || || 2
